Strategy: Bin-count-conditioned fit. When at least eight bins are open, rank like Best Fit and fill tightly; when fewer bins are open, place the item in the roomiest bin instead. The choice differs from Best Fit exactly when fewer than eight bins are open and a roomier bin exists. It may help by preserving tight bins while options are scarce, but may fail because spreading items early can strand capacity across bins that later cannot be combined.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) if len(bins) >= 8 else r for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Bin-count-conditioned fit: >=8 open bins -> Best Fit, else Worst Fit.
